findings.title: Candidate commits before all checked layout failures have been ruled out
findings.root_cause: Validator checks sibling weight sum only. Shared allocateMain also throws minimum sum overflow when accumulating clipped flex minima. The candidate is accepted before allocateMain runs.
findings.minimal_counterexample: Row { Text("a"); Text("b") }; initial empty valid Theme; startHeadless; snapshot(Int64.Max,0) succeeds; load Prepared theme with [components.text.spacing] weight=1 and min_width=9223372036854775807; snapshot(Int64.Max,0).
findings.expected: Recoverable Failed(InvalidCandidate or corresponding checked-layout diagnostic), old accepted theme/revision retained, active session remains usable.
findings.actual: Snapshot throws minimum sum overflow; result Applied(1); ThemeInfo candidate/revision1; post returns false because session closed.
findings.remediation: Cover all checked allocation invariants before accepted Theme/Info/cache mutation using stable cached declarations and the relevant layout constraints. Preserve ordinary valid clipped large minima; do not simply ban all large values.

findings.title: Product guide still describes explicit loading as future work
findings.evidence: Fixed HEAD exports and implements loadTheme/reloadTheme/themeInfo, but shipped guide says explicit loading belongs to a subsequent stage and describes no request usage.
findings.expected: Describe delivered asynchronous load/reload/query lifecycle accurately while leaving full component showcase as future work.
findings.remediation: Update the stale sentence and add concise public usage/terminal-result and accepted-file reload semantics.
